cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: I Know How to Fix Us
cards.instruction: Perform confidence about repairing the relationship while improvising every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. We can fix last night's shouting. Tea first, then one honest sentence each.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I don't want tea. I want you to listen without interrupting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Of course. Listening stage. I'll write down anything I want to interrupt with.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll be writing instead of listening.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you keep the pen. Supervised listening. If I interrupt, write it down; we'll start with that.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 sets repair order, A3 labels B objection a listening stage and A5 appoints B pen supervisor while naming a new stage, preserving superior process control through improvisation.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 no tea/listen demand causes A3 writing workaround; B4 writing distraction causes A5 B note-taking. Stock A3 question deferral is awkward but the actual method changes.

relationship.evidence: B2 requests a specific repair behavior and B4 catches the workaround flaw, forcing useful concrete revisions.

heightening.evidence: B4 flaw makes A5 surrender the pen while confidently naming supervised listening, a stronger improvised process built from the objection.

specificity.evidence: A1 last-night shouting and B2 interruption establish what repair requires; A3 pen and A5 monitoring are causally introduced.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 assigning B to supervise A turns concession into another supposedly planned stage, earned by B4.
